title: Remove the 'up to 3 visible' VN sprite-overlay limit (removed in 2.1)
description: Skill says: architecture.md:95 'VN-style character sprite overlays (up to 3 visible)'. Reality (2.1): the hard-coded three-sprite limit was removed from Roleplay sprite selection, setup, and display so chats can enable all uploaded sprite owners they need (CHANGELOG.md [2.1.0] Fixed, #3169). Fix: drop the '(up to 3 visible)' qualifier; say chats can show all enabled sprite owners.

title: Document the [custom_clip] Conversation-Call command (syntax + gating)
description: Skill says: the Conversation command list (architecture.md:85-88) and the Mari command-protocol note (character-cards.md:99) are silent on [custom_clip]. Reality (2.1): it is a hidden in-CALL character command with real syntax [custom_clip: label="short title", prompt="visual action or look"] (conversation-calls.routes.ts:736-740) — NOT a bare [custom_clip] as the changelog prose implies. It is only offered when Character Video Presence AND Custom Clips are both enabled (ttsSettings.callCharacterVideoEnabled && callCustomVideoClipsEnabled — packages/shared/src/types/tts.ts:150; conversation-calls.routes.ts:959,966) and a video connection exists (conversation-calls.routes.ts:1060), and the generated clip is saved into that character's Sprites -> Clips custom library (cap 128, call-character-videos.service.ts:115). It is regex-parsed like Mari's commands, not a public custom tool. Fix: add a [custom_clip] entry with the exact label/prompt syntax, the two gating toggles, the video-connection requirement, and that it persists to Sprites -> Clips.

title: Document the [react:] Conversation reaction command (incl. character-to-character)
description: Skill says: the Conversation-mode command list (architecture.md:85-88) mentions [selfie] and [memory: target=...] but not [react:]. Reality (2.1): characters can react to the user with [react: emoji="😂"] or a custom emoji [react: emoji=":name:"], and to another character with [react: emoji="🙄" to "Character Name"] (generate.routes.ts:3714; parser character-commands.ts:386-394 REACT_RE, which also accepts [react: "😂"] and [react: 😂]). It is Conversation-mode only (ignored elsewhere — generate.routes.ts:10593) and is gated by a per-command Reactions card toggle in Chat Settings / the setup wizard, toggled independently like Selfies or Music (CHANGELOG.md [2.1.0], #3219/#3210). Fix: add [react:] with all three forms and note the Reactions command-card toggle.

title: Document the /illustrate slash command
description: Skill says: the skill lists no slash commands for triggering illustrations. Reality (2.1): /illustrate (alias /ill) in Conversation, Roleplay, and Game chats triggers the same illustration action as the Gallery Illustrate button without opening the Gallery first (packages/client/src/lib/slash-commands.ts:1044-1048; game input matcher GameInput.tsx:102; CHANGELOG.md [2.1.0] Added). Fix: document /illustrate (and its /ill alias) as a user slash command available in all three chat modes.

title: Add a Sprites -> Clips (video-call presence clips) subsection distinct from expression sprites
description: Skill says: character-cards.md:152-154 'Sprite System' covers only VN expression sprites (happy.png/sad.png ...). Reality (2.1): Character AND Persona editors gained a separate 'Sprites -> Clips' section for reusable video-call presence clips — standard idle/talking/laughing/angry/crying/sighing slots plus named custom clips (kinds in packages/shared/src/types/conversation-call.ts:19-26; manifest ConversationCallCharacterVideoManifest with clips[] + customClips[] at conversation-call.ts:88-121), served at GET /api/characters/:id/gallery/clips (characters.routes.ts:768) with the custom library capped at 128 entries (call-character-videos.service.ts:115). This is a different feature from Expression Engine sprites. Fix: add a 'Sprites -> Clips' subsection describing the standard + custom video-call clip slots and their per-character manifest.

title: Document Gallery 'Videos' rename + Character/Persona Images/Videos tabs
description: Skill says: architecture.md:138 lists storage as 'gallery (generated images)'; character-cards.md:174 lists only image-gallery endpoints (GET /:id/gallery, /gallery/upload, /gallery/:imageId). Reality (2.1): Gallery 'clips' were renamed 'Videos' to cover Roleplay/Game/Conversation generated or uploaded video assets, and Character/Persona galleries are now split into Images / Videos tabs (CHANGELOG.md [2.1.0] Added). New video-gallery routes exist alongside images: GET /:id/gallery/videos/file/:filename and POST /:id/gallery/videos/upload (characters.routes.ts:1059,1107; persona equivalents 1823). Fix: note galleries hold images AND videos, describe the Images/Videos tabs, and add the video routes to the endpoint list.

title: Document user-uploaded MP4 support for gallery videos and call clips
description: Skill says: character-cards.md:174 documents only image gallery upload (/gallery/upload). Reality (2.1): users can upload MP4s to both Gallery Videos and reusable video-call clips — POST /:id/gallery/videos/upload, POST /:id/gallery/clips/upload, PATCH /:id/gallery/clips/:clipId/trim, DELETE /:id/gallery/clips/:clipId (characters.routes.ts:865,922,981,1059; persona equivalents 1823,1889), bounded by CALL_VIDEO_CLIP_UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES; uploaded clips can replace standard call-presence slots (Idle/Talking/...) or extend the custom call-clip library (up to 128 entries). Fix: document MP4 upload endpoints for gallery videos and Sprites -> Clips, plus the trim/delete controls and the 128-entry custom-clip cap.

title: Document 100-item library pagination (limit/offset + Load more)
description: Skill says: character-cards.md:169 lists the character list as a plain 'GET / — list' with no paging; architecture.md:145 is silent on pagination. Reality (2.1): GET /api/characters (also personas list and /api/lorebooks) accept limit/offset/search/sort/favoriteFilter and return server-paginated batches of 100 (LIBRARY_PAGE_LIMIT=100; parseLibraryPageQuery + toPaginatedList in packages/server/src/utils/list-pagination.ts:1,18,41; wired at characters.routes.ts:558-566 and 1446; lorebooks.routes.ts:393) yielding {items,limit,offset,hasMore}; the client shows a 'Load more' footer control and paginates favorites/non-favorites against the full library (CHANGELOG.md [2.1.0] Fixed, #3286). Fix: document the paginated list contract and the Load-more UI.

title: Add Video Generation providers + 'Default for Videos' connection role
description: Skill says: architecture.md:169 lists only image-gen providers (Pollinations, Stability, Together, NovelAI, ComfyUI, AUTOMATIC1111). Reality (2.1): a Video Generation surface was added — Google AI Studio (Gemini Omni/Veo), OpenRouter, Seedance 2.0, and xAI Imagine — with connection defaults, async job polling, MP4 download, and first/last-frame reference handling, plus a 'Default for Videos' connection role and an Advanced > Video Generation settings panel (CHANGELOG.md [2.1.0] Added). Fix: add a 'Video generation' providers bullet and note the 'Default for Videos' connection role.

title: Note animated Expression Engine portrait sprites (video -> looping GIF)
description: Skill says: character-cards.md:154 says the automated sprite-generation feature 'uses image gen + a pose prompt'. Reality (2.1): Expression Engine portrait generation can now use Video Generation connections to create short expression clips, convert them into looping GIF sprites, and save them into expression slots, with Advanced > Video Generation controls for duration and prompt templates (CHANGELOG.md [2.1.0] Added). Fix: note the animated-portrait option alongside the static image-gen path.

title: Note removal of the Gallery 'View latest' button (galleries are newest-first)
description: Skill says: the skill does not describe Gallery ordering controls. Reality (2.1): the Gallery 'View latest' button was removed because galleries already show newest images and videos first (CHANGELOG.md [2.1.0] Removed). (Note: a live 'View Latest' media/pinned-overlay affordance still exists for Roleplay/Game scene videos — a different surface.) Fix: if/when documenting the Gallery, state it lists newest-first and has no 'View latest' button.
